Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: After the first irrelevant search results, the Planner instructed the WebSurfer to repeat essentially the same query instead of adapting the strategy (e.g., using exact-match quotes, trying alternate/translated titles, adding context like “short film”/year, targeting credible databases, or opening candidate results). This early strategic error set the process on an unproductive loop and directly led to the failure to find the director and their place of birth.
